''See also: [[Burning Cloak Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Burning Cloak is a specialized [[Blackflame Enforcer technique]] that manifests as a translucent, hazy shroud of red and black fire surrounding the user. It is characterized by its volatile and explosive nature, providing sudden bursts of immense physical force, speed, and momentum. This makes the [[technique]] highly effective for rapid movements such as jumping, kicking, or delivering powerful punches that can shatter objects or pierce through enemies. However, the [[technique]] is not suited for tasks requiring steady strength, such as long-distance running or heavy lifting. Utilizing the Burning Cloak places significant strain on the user. It draws heavily upon [[Blackflame madra]], and its activation can cause physical agony, feeling like the tearing of one's soul or a searing of the [[spirit]] and [[madra channels]]. Because it is so taxing, users must carefully manage their energy reserves to avoid exhaustion. Mastering the [[technique]] requires extensive training to develop the precision necessary to control its explosive energy; without such discipline, a user might accidentally injure themselves or lose control of their movements. While it offers great offensive and mobility advantages, the [[technique]] is highly demanding on both the body and the [[spirit]].}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The Burning Cloak is an [[Enforcer technique]] utilized by [[Blackflame]] disciples. After attempting to form the ability, [[Lindon]] successfully ignited the [[technique]] to produce a distinct black-and-red light. This method provides the user with bursts of strength and explosive speed, which [[Lindon]] used to leap through flaring the power. Both [[Lindon]] and [[Orthos]] have employed this [[technique]] during their journey.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Burning Cloak is a [[technique]] fueled by [[Blackflame madra]] that manifests around [[Lindon]] whenever he taps his core. During combat, the effect can surge in intensity, though it is a resource that requires recovery after use. [[Lindon]] utilizes the cloak to close gaps with his opponents, though he must contend with environmental factors like [[water]] or specific auras that can dampen its power. He eventually learns to apply the principles of this [[technique]] to his [[pure core]] and even uses a cloak-empowered pull to heave [[Akura Harmony|Harmony]] from his feet.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The Burning Cloak manifests as a flame of black and red that outlines the user's body. [[Lindon]] utilizes this [[technique]] to cycle his energy and close the distance against an opponent. While [[Naian Blackflame|Naian]] employs a version of the cloak that is wilder and thicker than [[Lindon]]'s, [[Lindon]] uses his own to power his physical movements. Additionally, he can focus the black and red flames to surround his [[Forged Blackflame claws]].}}
